title: Practice 1: до, после, около, мимо, кроме, вместо, против…

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: I don't mind washing the dishes.
exercises.why: «против» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Acne is a very common problem, especially among teenagers.
exercises.ru: Угревая сыпь — весьма распространенная проблема, особенно среди ___.
exercises.why: «среди» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The prize money enabled me to go on a world cruise.
exercises.ru: Призовые деньги позволили мне отправиться в путешествие вокруг ___.
exercises.why: «вокруг» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I want to sit near the window.
exercises.why: «возле» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The road was closed because of fog.
exercises.why: «из-за» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Super technology weapons from the ancients always end up out of control.
exercises.ru: Супертехнологичное оружие древних всегда в конце концов выходит из-под ___.
exercises.why: «из-под» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It was the first time I'd walked along the Mogami River.
exercises.ru: Это был первый раз, когда я шёл вдоль ___ Могами.
exercises.why: «вдоль» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Irene Pepperberg holds a round tray in front of a parrot she has named Alex.
exercises.ru: Айрин Пеппербург держит круглый поднос напротив ___, названного ею Алексом.
exercises.why: «напротив» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Такому судье следует уйти на пенсию до ___ (наступление) пенсионного возраста.
exercises.prompt: Such a judge should retire from his job before retirement age.
exercises.why: «до» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: После ___ (полёт) в Европу наваливается усталость.
exercises.prompt: Fatigue follows a flight to Europe.
exercises.why: «после» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Стоимость обучения в Великобритании составляет около 9 000 ___ (фунты) стерлингов в год.
exercises.prompt: University fees in Britain are about £9,000 per year.
exercises.why: «около» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Как Том прошёл мимо ___ (охрана)?
exercises.prompt: How did Tom get past the guards?
exercises.why: «мимо» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он, кроме ___ (заштатный артист), ничего из себя не представляет.
exercises.prompt: He is nothing but a minor artist.
exercises.why: «кроме» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Вместо ___ (туша) во флаконе была какая-то странная жидкость.
exercises.prompt: Instead of ink there was some kind of strange fluid in the bottle.
exercises.why: «вместо» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Геноцид - это преступление против ___ (человечность).
exercises.prompt: Genocide is a crime against humanity.
exercises.why: «против» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Впереди среди ___ (деревья) наметился просвет.
exercises.prompt: Ahead, a clearing among the trees appeared.
exercises.why: «среди» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Она накрутила прядь волос вокруг ___ (палец).
exercises.prompt: She twisted a strand of hair around her finger.
exercises.why: «вокруг» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Воск плавится возле ___ (огонь).
exercises.why: «возле» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Судно было неустойчиво из-за ___ (перегруз).
exercises.prompt: The boat was off balance because it was overloaded.
exercises.why: «из-за» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Нужно выманить кошку из-под ___ (кровать).
exercises.prompt: You have to lure the cat out from under the bed.
exercises.why: «из-под» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
